proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Right to Act by Written Consent
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to permit shareholders holding the minimum votes needed to act to take action by written consent.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Independent Chair Policy
proposals.proponent: The Sisters of St. Francis of Philadelphia
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to adopt a policy requiring the Board Chair, whenever possible, to be an independent director.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Report on Lobbying Activities
proposals.proponent: The International Brotherhood of Teamsters General Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report disclosing Pfizer's direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, trade association and ALEC memberships, and oversight.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.
